staticBaseUrl.description: Optional asset base for this component. A non-empty value overrides window.usxBaseUrl in React or STATIC_URL in Django; otherwise the global base or / is used. Asset filenames remain separate.

size.description: Controls the diameter of the spinner. Matches USWDS icon size scale (1–9).

color.description: USWDS color token applied as text-{color}, e.g. 'primary', 'white', 'accent-cool'.

label.description: Visible label text displayed beside the spinner.

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the wrapper element.
